objective.primaryRule: Primary decision statistic (PROTOCOL.md §1.1): per (cutoff, cell, replicate R3-R34) pair, D = V(EXP lane) - V(CTRL lane), V = the best qualified (P0, Q1-Q6) centre net among the lane's selectable members (CTRL: its shortlist; EXP: its shortlist and the OFF projections of its ON members), V = $0 without a qualified member; material improvement at a cutoff iff mean D >= $10,000 and the 0.10 quantile of the cell-stratified paired bootstrap (B = 100,000) > 0; the precommitted outcome label (§1.4) uses C21 and C24 (primary), the risk non-inferiority margins (+$2,500; +2 points of breach share) and the mechanism requirement. Pooled selection per (cutoff, arm): P0 = NL0 1.0.0's actual-profit rule (highest centre net; ties selection robust, lower centre DD, label) over the arm's qualified population. No selector launches an evaluation.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (C0, not peak account equity); both arms keep P0 (nl0-control@1.0.0: marked DD <= $35,000) exactly; trade principal loss and banked-capital DD (liquidation basis) are reported, never gated

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres; refinement moves apart): 384 independent lanes x (512 screen + 2-6 islands x 256) = 393,216 configured base / 786,432 maximum (the extension block's islands 7-9 and the 48 informed lanes come out of the same ceiling). Backend evaluations: the HARD CEILING of 25,000,000 REQUESTED official evaluations (archive hits included) over every official stage (ablation, search, extension block, informed lanes, qualification, decomposition, intervals), enforced by a running ledger over the sealed stage records: each stage's Lab gets maxFresh = min(its own deterministic worst case, the remaining ceiling) and is launched only if the remaining ceiling >= its worst case x 1.25. Per-lane deterministic caps (Assignment 3's laneWorstCase with the arm's move bound): broad CTRL 41,000 (= Stage B) / EXP 42,000; extended (islands x 1.5) 56,000 / 57,000; informed 90,000 / 93,000. Per qualification member 654, per interval subject 265. Expected about 10 M (Stage B's measured lanes: ~16,000 requested per broad lane). Counted separately per job, arm, lane, rung tag, cutoff and stage: requested, fresh, archive hits; the E5 benchmark and report-only CPU diagnostics are not research evaluations.

evaluationBackend.notes: Every official evaluation runs only through openOfficialGpuSession -> GpuPool -> EvalLab on the accepted GPU Phase 8 evaluator (staged-stop delivery, protocol v3, capability bits D1_STAGED_STOP / G_STAGED_STOP; record pinned in the freeze), with the risk envelope requested on every evaluation; no CPU fallback, auto backend or hybrid. CPU runs only under non-official purposes: parity-test (Phase 8), benchmark (E5) and diagnostic (report-only replays of frozen subjects).

chronologicalConsequence: Standard 3.0.0 §1.8 default, adopted: the study runs three cutoffs (C19 secondary; C21, C24 primary) each with one next interval and no sequential fold path (departure PD1), so every selection is labelled 'no chronological support: not a deployment-qualified candidate without an explicit user decision'. The study's own chronological check (PROTOCOL.md §9.3: the three fold primaries' interval P&L sum > 0 and every reset interval DD <= $35,000) is descriptive and enters only the study's outcome label, never this consequence. The next intervals (C19 -> 2020-2021, C21 -> 2022-2023, C24 -> 2025-2026) are retrospective, previously inspected history, never a pristine holdout. 'No qualifying candidate' in a lane or an arm is a valid outcome (V = $0); keeping S1 OFF is a valid result. Governance only: never a fitness term, ranking input or gate.

deviations.description: Three cutoffs (C19 secondary; C21, C24 primary) with one next interval each instead of the C19/C21/C23 repeat with a sequential verdict; consequence: no chronological support for any selection under the standard (the study's descriptive chronological check of PROTOCOL.md §9.3 does not change that).
deviations.userAgreement: brief/BRIEF.md §6 (cutoffs C19, C21, C24; C21 and C24 primary; chronological folds C19 -> 2020-21, C21 -> 2022-23, C24 -> 2025-26)

deviations.description: Incumbent-informed lanes I1-I4 (8 paired replicates at C24) are separately labelled diagnostics with no chronological claim; New L0 and N/original are frozen benchmarks and informed centres, never members of the independent populations, never nominated.
deviations.userAgreement: brief/BRIEF.md §6 (informed lanes I1-I4, 8 paired replicates, C24, not independent chronological evidence)

deviations.description: Reduced structural scope: Stage B's two cells (GA0.VA0, GB0.VD1) x 32 replicates (R3-R18 = Stage B's seeds, R19-R34 new) per arm; effort scaled only by replicates; no claim of equal effort with Assignment 3 or NL0.
deviations.justification: brief §6 (64 pairs per cutoff, 32 per cell)

deviations.description: Both arms' 128 lanes of a cutoff run concurrently in one official job; lane results do not depend on the grouping (lane-key seeds, lane-local extension decisions at barriers, deterministic records, a per-lane resource guard that cannot bind); gate R verifies reproduction of Stage B's sealed CTRL lanes.
Qualification and intervals add one report-only stress, stop slippage +10 bps, beside Assignment 3's six.

A single symmetric extension block re-runs every budget-bound lane of both arms with the island cap x 1.5 when more than 25 % of either arm's lanes of a cutoff end budget-bound; decided from stop reasons only.
deviations.justification: the audit's proposed protocol §6; brief §6 (budget-bound lanes reported, extension symmetric)

deviations.description: The execution shape (8 host workers, batch 8,192, linger 30 ms) is the accepted evaluator's measured Mode S; the E5 benchmark measures throughput for forecasts only; timings select nothing.
